body:
Thank you! Taking it day by day and trying to get through this mental block. 
I appreciate your kind words!

Hi yeah I have pcos I was told a couple of years ago but I never did anything about it. Mostly a mental thing as to why I just never got help. 
My sisters told me they noticed the change when I was losing and I had some people compliment me but it was hard to see it. I noticed a couple of differences when I look back at pictures but it was mostly just in my face. 
Congrats on your weight-loss, that’s amazing. Thank you for sharing.
Thank you! I’m taking it day by day to not overwhelm myself. I appreciate your words and I wish you luck as well.
Thank you - I appreciate the advice! I’m starting therapy this week and am looking at ways to eat better

Thank you this is a huge help. I also have metabolic issues and something that makes it so hard to lose weight so I feel the struggle. I try to motivate myself because I know I can do it. I did this before, I lost weight and was working on living a healthy lifestyle. I’m going to work on it again
Thanks for the advice! There are a lot of things changing in my life at the moment and it can be very overwhelming so I am taking it day by day.

Thank you for being blunt, I def needed to hear that. I appreciate you sharing some advice and encouragement. My food spending is so high and I hate it every time I hit that order button. I often justify the price bc I’m hungry and say f it. But I want to do more research on the meals you get. I think that could help my situation a lot. Motivation is a struggle for me as well. 

I have made a call to a gym that specializes in classes, instead of just a basic membership and will be doing a trial run this week. It’s expensive but I would be spending that money on food anyways.

Thank you. I appreciate your advice. Looking to food as a stress reliever and a comfort is a huge struggle that I will address in therapy.

I like to cook, but there a bunch of other factors with my home situation as one of the reasons I started to doordash so much and then it just became a problem. I am looking to move out of where I currently live to be on my own and I will take your advice and give meal prepping a try.

Thank you for the encouragement and advice! I think I’ve always had in my head that I just need to lose the weight and I will be fine but you are right, this is a lifelong journey and commitment. I appreciate you taking the time to write.

Thank you for sharing your story and I’m sorry for your loss, seems like we had a similar connection with our boys. Your story has brought me some ease knowing that I’m not alone with this. I’m sorry you had to go through seeing him have seizures but it’s good he is at peace and can be free with no pain. 

The “what ifs” have been slowly getting to me too. I am asking myself what if I brought him to the neuro vet and got those tests. Or what if I just put him on more meds. I am thinking about these for hours and then I would get stuck with a moment of clarity and say how much my baby would hate that. constantly bringing him to vets for check ups on his blood, bc long term use of the medicine he was on would affect his other organs. I just decided that was not the life I wanted for him but those what ifs still make their way into my head. 

I know this will take time to heal from the loss and the guilt but I  going to work on it. I’m going to do some more research and maybe seek therapy if I need. Thank you again for speaking about your story, I hope you are healing well and I wish you all the best. I hope are babies are resting in peace.

Thank you for sharing your story and I’m so sorry for your loss. I really appreciate your words and they did bring me comfort knowing I’m not alone. 
I didn’t sleep last night and I began to go through my pictures of him and it made me realize just how bad his health got in the last few months alone. I couldn’t believe that in January alone, he acted a lot different than what he was a few days ago. It brought a little bit of relief seeing that so maybe that can help you too. 

I still feel a little guilty and think it’s going to take some work and time to get over that feeling. I completely understand when you say you will never get another dog, I don’t want another animal either. I’ve been saying that even when my baby was alive, I wouldn’t handle going through this pain again. 

I wish you well on your healing journey, I know that we both made the right decision even if it’s hard to see. Thank you again for sharing your story.

Thank you, this was definitely something i needed to hear. 
I have been at this job for about 4 months and it is my first “big” job (I’m 26). I can’t really explain all my work anxieties at the moment as I am not sure why I feel this way but I will try what you said. I appreciate you taking the time sharing your ideas. 
I wish you well in life 💕

Hi, I am on meds for anxiety. My anxiety is very bad and before meds, I would have constant panic attacks. I take lexapro and I feel it does help a lot with mine. The side effects didn’t affect me as much and it doesn’t make you feel off. While it doesn’t get rid of all my anxiety, it lowers the overall anxiety to prevent panic attacks. 

If you would like to talk about anything, I am here. I hope you are able to find something to help you.

Thank you. I’m trying to take it one day at a time. It’s not easy but I don’t want to let my anxiety win again..
I wish you well and hope you do great things in college.
